- advisory-followup dedupe in step 18
  PROBLEM: the advisory-followup dedupe checks the `<!-- ai:security-finding:<id> -->` marker only against open `ai:security` issues plus the per-project `security_pass_followup_issues` state.
  WHY: a follow-up issue that an operator closes without fixing can be re-filed by a later project that re-encounters the same pre-existing finding; the 5-per-run cap bounds the noise.
